name: Bogdan Andrzej Zdrojewski - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Erasmus+ programme for the period 2028-2034, and repealing Regulations (EU) 2021/817 and (EU) 2021/888
part_text:
The European Parliament's culture committee wants a bigger, more inclusive Erasmus+ programme for 2028–2034. It asks for about 47.4 billion euro instead of the Commission's 40.8 billion, with guaranteed minimum shares for schools, universities, vocational training, adult learning, youth, volunteering and sport. It also wants the European Solidarity Corps folded into Erasmus+, more money and support for people with fewer opportunities, simpler application rules, and a say for Parliament over how the money is spent.

- The budget rises to about 47.4 billion euro, with fixed minimum shares per education sector.
- People with fewer opportunities get at least 20% of mobility places, plus housing and travel help.
- This is Parliament's first-reading position; talks with EU governments come next.
